_comment: PERMANENT exemptions, one per file+term pair. Every entry states WHY, and the reason
must survive a hostile read — 'it is hard to change' is not a reason. This file is not
where debt goes; that is checks/vocabulary-baseline.json, which may only shrink.
The bar: a term is exempt only when the user is BETTER OFF seeing it. Two things clear
it. A product name the user typed themselves ('Claude Code', 'Codex'). And a hidden
search synonym that is never rendered, so someone who learned the old vocabulary can
still find the control that hides it.
"reason": "one sentence that says why the reader is better off" }
